# Bundled license provenance

Tcl-8.6.12-LICENSE.txt is the unmodified Tcl 8.6.12 license from:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tcltk/tcl/core-8-6-12/license.terms

It accompanies the Tcl runtime in the Windows distribution. The Windows build
also copies licenses from the installed Python, Tk and scientific dependency
distributions into THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES. Its runtime-versions.json records the
build's actual versions. This does not change the MIT license of this project's
own code.

Additional unmodified runtime license texts:

- OpenSSL 3.5.8: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openssl/openssl/openssl-3.5.8/LICENSE.txt
- libffi: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/libffi/libffi/v3.4.4/LICENSE
